name: 21074 · Hampstead, MD
findings: ZIP 21074 (Hampstead) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21074 (Hampstead) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 21074 (Hampstead) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).
